outcome: Atom Controller refuses every run root that overlaps the approved product change surface, while an external run root preserves the existing lifecycle and reports only real product changes.
practical_value: Promotion review can never mistake controller requests, baselines, ledgers, or evidence for product work.
stopping_condition: The real Atom Controller CLI completes the external-root case, rejects the overlapping-root case before creating output, and derives a change surface containing no controller-owned paths.

captured_cases.expected_outcome: An external controller run starts and its change surface contains no controller-owned path.
A controller run nested below an allowed product path is refused before any run directory is created.
